## Current position

**2021–present — Tenured Associate Professor (*Maître de conférences*) in Sociology**, Université Côte d’Azur; member of GREDEG (UMR 7321 CNRS).

## Previous positions and education

- **2020–2021** — Probationary Associate Professor (*Maître de conférences stagiaire*), Université Côte d’Azur / GREDEG (UMR 7321); teacher-training programme (DUo, CAP-UCA).
- **2019–2020** — Contract Associate Professor, Université Côte d’Azur / GREDEG (UMR 7321).
- **2017–2018** — Postdoctoral researcher, Institut Mines-Télécom Business School; member of LITEM (EA 7363).
- **2017** — Qualification for Associate Professor positions in Sociology and Demography (CNU Section 19).
- **2016–2017** — ATER, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès; member of CERTOP (UMR 5044).
- **2012–2016** — Doctoral researcher (three-year doctoral contract) and then ATER, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès / CERTOP (UMR 5044). PhD in Sociology supervised by Franck Cochoy; DCCE, ED TESC and Ludovia summer-school training.
- **2011–2012** — Research Master 2 in Sociology, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès, specialization *Travail Organisation et Marché*, highest honours (*Mention Très Bien*). Research topic: digital information and communication technologies and consumption; supervisor: Franck Cochoy.
- **2010–2011** — Research Master 1 in Sociology, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès, specialization *Travail Organisation et Marché*, highest honours. Research topic: consumer mobility and sustainable cities; supervisors: Michèle Lalanne and Franck Cochoy.
- **2009–2010** — Bachelor’s degree in Sociology, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès, specialization in economic sociology.
- **2007–2009** — DEUG in Sociology, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès, specialization in economic sociology.
- **2006–2007** — DAEU A, Université Toulouse Jean Jaurès, social-science and mathematics options.
